description: Show one of the user's OWN images, audio files or texture sets in the R3 Community, or hide it again: the same switch as 'Show in Community' in the R3 app. public: true makes it visible to every R3 member, who can then find it in the Community lists and use it in their own projects; public: false hides it again (call this tool again with public: false to undo). A texture set is shown or hidden with all its maps; a map of a texture set is not switched on its own (switch the set). Use it only when the user asked to share or hide that asset. Ids come from r3_image_list, r3_audio_list and r3_texture_read / r3_texture_create. Needs asset:share. Videos, Blender models and projects are shared in the R3 app.

id.description: The asset's id, as the list tools report it.

public.description: true shows it in the Community (every R3 member can see and use it); false hides it again.

type.description: What the id names: image, audio (an audio file) or textureSet (a texture set, its setId).

name: r3_asset_share

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Show or hide one of your images, audio files or texture sets in the Community
